source_text: Oravit Isaac pro Rebecca sterili; concepit. Duae gentes in utero — ecclesia et synagoga, vel spiritus et caro.
pass_a_gloss: Prayed Isaac for Rebecca barren; she-conceived. Two nations in womb — church and synagogue, or spirit and flesh.
pass_b_english: [[Isaac prayed for barren Rebecca; she conceived >> Bible:Genesis 25:21]]. [[Two nations in the womb >> Bible:Genesis 25:23]] — church and synagogue, or spirit and flesh.
